description: Import post SEO meta from CSV in the seo_export_csv format (header row, then one row per post with at least 7 columns; export first and edit that). Give the CSV inline (csv) or as a local .csv path (csv_file). It is sent as the raw text/csv request body. Returns { success, errors } row counts.

csv.description: CSV text including the header row

csv_file.description: Absolute path to a local .csv file

name: seo_import_csv
